settings.heading: Let Us Beat Your Quote — the terms

settings.text:
Found the same piece cheaper somewhere else? Send us the quote and we will look at it properly.

Not every quote works the same way, and this is the part worth reading before you send one. A recent written custom quote from a real competitor, for something genuinely comparable, is the kind we can offer a guarantee on. Older quotes, active online listings and other companies' group buys we will still review and still often beat — but they come with no guarantee attached, because we cannot verify them the same way.

We will tell you which category yours falls into before you decide anything.

We compare like with like: the same metal, the same stone specification, the same workmanship. A lower number for a different piece is not a lower price for the same piece, and we will show you our reasoning rather than simply saying no.

The terms that govern this are below.
